pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions exhibit high edge angularity with complex, stellate (star-like) geometries and sharp pixel gradients. Spatial area is greatest on the mid-flank, transitioning to smaller, highly fragmented clusters on the hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light pelage forms a continuous topological graph. Junction nodes are numerous and primarily multi-way. Pixel thickness of the corridors is variable, narrowing significantly where jagged patch protrusions approach one another.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck and shoulder presents a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated profile against the background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A dark, localized feature or mass is visible on the upper lateral neck region. A distinct physical protrusion is observed on the ventral midline.
other_distinctive_markers: The overall pelage pattern is characterized by high irregularity and a distinctive jagged, 'vine-leaf' motif across the flank.
